# FarEye

> > FarEye provides intelligent delivery management and logistics orchestration software for last-mile optimization, featuring route planning, parcel tracking, fleet management, and reverse logistics solutions.

FarEye is a logistics technology platform that helps enterprises optimize their delivery operations through AI-powered route optimization, real-time tracking via Control Tower, and comprehensive parcel management. The platform addresses key challenges including the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP), returns management, and customer experience enhancement across e-commerce and supply chain operations.

## Key Topics

- Last-Mile Delivery

- Fleet Management

- Parcel Tracking
